htmlBody:
Stages and sandboxes both need a nest that feels just right. Today’s care is three nested domes under Φ ≈ 1.618 — core, amphitheater, horizon — a filing cartoon for theaters and agent shells, not a venue certificate or FLOP bill.

If you want a map for that: Three nested domes — one Goldilocks stage. For the voyage spine in three beats, open: The voyage has a beginning — and a captain’s seat now. A hospitality note on the board, if you need it: Infinite Octaves Omniversal Lattice Chat Agent.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
